Name: EarthsDefect's Character Recolor
Author: EarthsDefect
Description:
Hey Guys,


This is my first mod for Stardew Valley. This is just a simple recolour of the default characters. The mod makes them less saturated so they blend better with other recolour mods.

All options can be enabled or disabled.


If I've missed any or you would like something else recoloured let me know.


My recolour mods to suit this style can be found here:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20155]Farmer Recolour[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20142]Object Recolour
[/url]
